<TD VALIGN="bottom" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">63,580</FONT></TD>
<TD NOWRAP VALIGN="bottom"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(84,391</FONT></TD>
<TD NOWRAP VALIGN="bottom"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">)&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(106,961</FONT></TD>
<TD NOWRAP VALIGN="bottom"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">)&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Differences From Previous Forecasts
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Revenues and operating income for fiscal 2010 are projected to be largely in line with the previous business forecasts announced on
February&nbsp;3, 2011, despite damage to buildings and production facilities, as well as in-process products caused by the Great East Japan Earthquake. This is due to Group-wide efforts to restore production lines after the earthquake and the
benefits of ongoing business structure reforms. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Net other deductions and income before income taxes are expected to be the same as previous
forecasts due to a decline in exchange losses and other factors, offset by losses on fixed assets and a deterioration in equity in net (earnings) loss of affiliated companies resulting from the Great East Japan Earthquake. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Furthermore, net income attributable to Hitachi, Ltd. is projected to be in line with the previous forecast, with a decline in deductions of net income
attributable to noncontrolling interests offsetting higher income taxes. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><U>Cautionary Statement </U></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Certain statements found in this document may constitute &#147;forward-looking statements&#148; as defined in the U.S. Private Securities Litigation
Reform Act of 1995. Such &#147;forward-looking statements&#148; reflect management&#146;s current views with respect to certain future events and financial performance and include any statement that does not directly relate to any historical or
current fact. Words such as &#147;anticipate,&#148; &#147;believe,&#148; &#147;expect,&#148; &#147;estimate,&#148; &#147;forecast,&#148; &#147;intend,&#148; &#147;plan,&#148; &#147;project&#148; and similar expressions which indicate future events

or implied in the &#147;forward-looking statements&#148; and from historical trends. Certain &#147;forward-looking statements&#148; are based upon current assumptions of future events which may not prove to be accurate. Undue reliance should not be
placed on &#147;forward-looking statements,&#148; as such statements speak only as of the date of this document. </FONT></P>

and Exchange Commission and in other materials published by Hitachi. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Hitachi, Ltd. </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi, Ltd., (NYSE: HIT / TSE: 6501), headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, is a leading global electronics company with approximately 360,000 employees
worldwide. Fiscal 2009 (ended March&nbsp;31, 2010) consolidated revenues totaled 8,968 billion yen ($96.4 billion). Hitachi will focus more than ever on the Social Innovation Business, which includes information and telecommunication systems, power
systems, environmental, industrial and transportation systems, and social and urban systems, as well as the sophisticated materials and key devices that support them. For more information on Hitachi, please visit the company&#146;s website at
<U>http://www.hitachi.com</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"># # # </FONT></P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><A NAME="fs177026_2"></A>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Hitachi Announces Recognizing Extraordinary Item </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>on an Unconsolidated Basis </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Tokyo, April&nbsp;27, 2011 &#151;</B> Hitachi, Ltd.
(NYSE:HIT / TSE:6501) today announced that the Company plans to post 52.9 billion yen in write-downs of subsidiaries and affiliated companies shares in line with a decline in market price or actual price as an extraordinary loss on an unconsolidated
basis for the fiscal year ended March&nbsp;31, 2011. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Hitachi, Ltd. </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi, Ltd., (NYSE: HIT / TSE: 6501), headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, is a leading global electronics company with approximately 360,000 employees worldwide. Fiscal 2009 (ended March&nbsp;31, 2010)
consolidated revenues totaled 8,968 billion yen ($96.4 billion). Hitachi will focus more than ever on the Social Innovation Business, which includes information and telecommunication systems, power systems, environmental, industrial and
transportation systems, and social and urban systems, as well as the sophisticated materials and key devices that support them. For more information on Hitachi, please visit the company&#146;s website at http://www.hitachi.com. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"># # # </FONT></P>
